note: Optional research leads for records dated 1989–2008. The compiler checks email for their unspecified volume. Collection titles, release dates and FOIA identifiers retain their original wording; only in-period records may enter the research packet.

dossiers.title: 1989–1992, Volume IV, Soviet Union, Russia, and Post-Soviet States: Policy
dossiers.topic: NSC policy formation and source coverage
dossiers.collection: Records of the National Security Council: Condoleezza Rice 1989–1990 Subject Files
dossiers.sourceLabel: Bush 41 Library finding aid and container list
dossiers.access: Arms Control [1] is listed On Site. A catalog entry is not a reviewed document.
dossiers.task: Use Rice’s NSC staff files to trace policy formation; coordinate the arms-control overlap.
dossiers.comparison: Keep staff advice distinct from a presidential decision and from high-level meeting records.
dossiers.selection: staff-file lead with separate decision and agency follow-up requests

questions.question: DANN-E removed the container label. Restore the Rice file request.
questions.wrong: Any Bush presidential box; Rice wrote all of them.
questions.receipt: Request slip: Rice Subject Files, CF00715-001; on-site retrieval lead.

questions.question: The folder concerns arms control. Where does it fit?
questions.correct: Coordinate overlapping coverage before selecting records.
questions.wrong: Put every arms-control record in this volume.
questions.receipt: Scope note: coordinate related volumes; do not duplicate their remit.

questions.question: DANN-E calls a staff paper “the President’s order.” Repair the note.
questions.correct: Verify author, recipient, date and approval evidence.
questions.wrong: Attribute it to Bush because it is in his library.
questions.receipt: Source sheet: NSC staff provenance retained; presidential approval not inferred.

questions.question: This lead covers 1989–1990. File the research report.
questions.correct: Log the date limits and gaps; seek State evidence.
questions.wrong: Mark the whole research plan complete from one file.
questions.receipt: Research packet: Rice lead, State comparison, and coverage questions.

dossiers.title: 1993–2000, Volume XVIII, Russia: High-Level Contacts
dossiers.collection: Clinton Presidential Records: NSC Cable, Email, and Records Management System
dossiers.handle: MDR 2015-0782-M-2; Clinton Digital Library item 57569; April 21, 1996–December 31, 1999
dossiers.access: A declassified MDR set, not a FOIA request; individual documents still need examination.
dossiers.task: Build a high-level contacts chronology from Clinton–Yeltsin memcons and telcons.
dossiers.comparison: Keep conversation dates distinct from preparation dates and preserve each record’s form.
dossiers.selection: dated memcon/telcon leads with a gap register for the rest of 1993–2000

questions.question: DANN-E labeled this set “FOIA, all eight years.” Correct the request.
questions.receipt: Request slip: MDR 2015-0782-M-2, digital item 57569; limited date span.

questions.question: Sort these conversation records into a chronology.
questions.correct: Use conversation date; retain memcon/telcon identity.
questions.wrong: Sort by upload date and merge both record types.
questions.receipt: Chronology rule: event date first; drafting dates and record types retained separately.

questions.question: Prepare annotation backup for a quotation.
questions.correct: Verify the scan; log document/page and mark the passage.
questions.wrong: Quote the catalog description as the leaders’ words.
questions.receipt: Annotation backup: only checked document passages may support quotations; retain the MDR identifier.

questions.question: This set covers only part of the record. What goes to review?
questions.correct: Candidate chronology, date limits, and unresolved gaps.
questions.wrong: A claim that this set completes all 1993–2000 contacts.
questions.receipt: Research packet: candidates and date gaps; compare related policy files.

dossiers.title: 2001–2008, Volume XLIII, China, 2001–2004
dossiers.collection: George W. Bush Presidential Electronic Records: NSC EP-3 collision records
dossiers.sourceLabel: Bush 43 Library finding aid, November 17, 2025, pages 1–2
dossiers.access: 177 assets released in full; 22 withheld in part; 16 withheld in full. Some classified records are unprocessed.
dossiers.task: Trace the EP-3 response without substituting public messaging for the decision record.
dossiers.comparison: Distinguish press guidance, draft statements, bulletins and email from final policy instructions.
dossiers.selection: NSC electronic-record leads, a document-type register and explicit access gaps

questions.question: DANN-E offers “the complete China archive.” Identify the actual set.
questions.receipt: Request slip: EP-3 FOIA 2017-0023-F; ARMS source system retained.

questions.question: The set includes drafts and press guidance. Select responsibly.
questions.correct: Trace revisions and seek the underlying policy instruction.
questions.wrong: Treat every draft statement as a final presidential decision.
questions.receipt: Comparison note: drafts and public lines are not proof of final authorization.

questions.question: The inventory lists 215 assets. Record the access gap.
questions.correct: 177 full, 22 partial, 16 withheld; log unprocessed records.
questions.wrong: All 215 fully released; no remaining gaps.
questions.receipt: Access register: full/partial/withheld distinguished; unprocessed material remains a gap.

questions.question: Prepare the EP-3 archival research packet.
questions.correct: File EP-3 leads; flag gaps and further research needs.
questions.wrong: Call the incident file a complete, cleared China manuscript.
questions.receipt: Research packet: incident trail, withholding log, wider-period research still required.
